text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Satono
Diamond have
come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has achieved great success in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, we're still working towards our
goal of
making her into an illustrious
runner.

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: We're begging you! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Rice! Bourbon! We want to race you
both!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Which race are you entering next?! We'll
enter it
as well!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah! Wh-wh-what do you mean?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We're not satisfied with merely running
against
you in a scrimmage. We wish to
face you in an
actual race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but why us?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We recently had the opportunity to
compete
against McQueen and Teio.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I learned so many things racing them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm still so inexperienced, and I realized I
need to
further my studies by running
against other
accomplished athletes,
such as yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So Teio and McQueen suggested that
we try
running against you two next!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll be able to learn lots from
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I have no objections to your

proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Racing the two of you would also be
beneficial
for me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh... I-if you really want to race
against
m-me, then, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you both for agreeing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome. I'm really excited to run
with the
three of you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As am I. I will reach out after finding the
most
optimal race for all of us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we managed to secure a
race with
Rice and Bourbon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I clutch my head in my hands upon
hearing
Satono Diamond's
announcement. I can't believe
she just
went soliciting people for matches.
choice_data_list: 次からは、行く前に報告してくれ……
次からは、行く前に報告して……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to put in a formal request to
Rice Shower
and Mihono Bourbon later.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I should leave any future
race
negotiations up to you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd like to run against
Hayahide and
the BNW members next.
Oh, and I've also already
promised to
race Nature and the others. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
After that, I want to compete against
Spe,
Suzuka, and Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, and Rudolf too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! There are so many people I
have to
defeat if I want a shot at being
the best in
Japan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond speaks with genuine joy
in her
voice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her first order of business as an
illustrious runner
is to aim to be the best
in the country and
challenge many
formidable runners with Kitasan
Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is Satono Diamond's current goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm still seeking the strength and
purpose fitting
of an illustrious runner...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So let's have another good training
session today!
